releases.summary: Fixes for Revit 2027 add-in deployment and the SheetMatrix tolerance issue.

changes.title: SheetMatrix Tolerance
changes.description: A tolerance value is introduced to enhance the detection of viewport locations relative to the matrix.

changes.title: Revit 2027 Deployment Fix
changes.description: Fixed an issue preventing proper deployment of add-in files for Revit 2027.

releases.summary: Improved version availability notifications and added Revit 2027 support.

changes.title: Revit 2027 Support
changes.description: The add-in is now compatible with Revit 2027.

changes.title: New Version Availability Notifications
changes.description: Enhanced the version-checking mechanism to notify users when a new version is available.

releases.summary: Fix: Sheet Tools Turning Off Unexpectedly

changes.title: Fixed Sheet Tools Turning Off Unexpectedly
changes.description: Resolved an issue that caused the Sheet Tools to become disabled after running for a period of time.
